concept: A massive concrete barrier or wall cracking and crumbling down its center, with deep fissures spreading outward like a spider web. The wall is institutional gray, geometric, cold. One side shows oil pooling at the base in dark amber tones. The opposite side shows fragments falling into an abyss of darkness below. The composition is symmetrical but destabilizing—the wall divides the frame vertically, suggesting collapse from internal pressure. Harsh, flat lighting. Industrial aesthetic. Sense of imminent structural failure.
explanation: Today's headlines reveal systems failing simultaneously across multiple domains—political (Spain's housing crisis, France's education collapse), infrastructural (Kyiv being torn apart, Hawaii's arch crumbling), and moral (execution gone wrong, AI used to victimize again, women needing shorts to prevent assault). Rather than depicting any single crisis, this image captures the pervasive sensation of institutional collapse: the walls we've built to protect us are fracturing from pressures we can't contain. The oil reference acknowledges desperate attempts to shore up stability through force.

headlines.title: G7 to release millions of barrels of oil and diesel after Trump threat
headlines.summary: The co-ordinated release is aimed at heading off further price spikes and avoiding a ban on US diesel exports.

headlines.title: US murderer Christa Pike unconscious and on ventilator after failed execution, lawyers say
headlines.summary: As of Thursday night, Pike remained critically ill and is being treated at a hospital in Nashville, Tennessee.

headlines.title: Cornell frat house rape accuser 'under siege' online, says lawyer
headlines.summary: A lawyer for Jane Doe says she is "not doing well" amid attempts to uncover her identity.

headlines.title: Riot police clash with students as education protests rage in France
headlines.summary: About 735 schools have faced disruption as violent protests over standards and lack of teachers continue.

headlines.title: Spanish PM Sánchez loses key housing crisis vote after eviction of woman, 87
headlines.summary: The defeat raises pressure on Sánchez to call a snap election, after a series of scandals affecting his party and allies.

headlines.title: US road rage killer's sentence quashed because AI video of victim was shown in court
headlines.summary: The Arizona appeals court ruled that airing an AI message from the dead victim "crossed that line".

headlines.title: Women given shorts at Oktoberfest to prevent upskirting
headlines.summary: The step at the Munich festival comes after thousands of voyeuristic videos emerged on social media.

headlines.title: Intensified Russian strikes are tearing Kyiv apart, warns mayor
headlines.summary: Vitaliy Klitschko says Ukraine's capital is in a "very dramatic situation" as Russia hits critical infrastructure.

headlines.title: 'I was not going to let others die' - pilot of Flydubai flight describes cockpit attack by co-pilot
headlines.summary: Capt Smit Machchhar tells Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi he opened the cockpit door to let others in during the attack.

headlines.title: Hawaii's iconic 550-year-old Hōlei Sea Arch collapses
headlines.summary: The lava rock formation protruding from the rocky cliffs of Volcanoes National Park crumbled some time last weekend.

headlines.title: Japan's first mayor to take maternity leave lands on TIME100 Next list
headlines.summary: Shoko Kawata's maternity leave drew mixed reactions in Japan, a country struggling to lift birth rates.

headlines.title: Renee Good: Family of US woman killed by ICE agent sues Trump officials
headlines.summary: Lawyers for Good's family say US officials created "an unprecedented environment for state sponsored violence" in Minneapolis.
